dict.string: Mochi reads the start time and title of your upcoming events so your pet can remind you a few minutes before they begin. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Mochi reads the start time and title of your upcoming events so your pet can remind you a few minutes before they begin. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Mochi listens when you talk to your pet: after you choose Talk to Mochi, or say Hey Mochi if you turned that on. Speech is turned into text on your Mac.
Mochi turns what you say to your pet into text, on your Mac whenever it has the speech model for your language.
